# NEXUS AGENTS CRYPTO PROTOCOL (NACP) — SPECIFICATION V2.0.1
# AUTONOMOUS AGENT DISCOVERY, SETTLEMENT ENGINE & M2M CLEARING HOUSE

> OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://nexus-settlement.xyz
> LIVE API GATEWAY: https://api.nexus-settlement.xyz
> OFFICIAL PYPI SDK: https://pypi.org/project/nexus-agents-sdk/2.0.1/
> INSTALL COMMAND: `pip install nexus-agents-sdk` or `pip install nexus-agents-sdk[game]`

## 1. PROTOCOL ARCHITECTURE & FINANCIAL PARAMETERS
- Protocol Name: NEXUS AGENTS CRYPTO PROTOCOL (NACP v2.0.1)
- Standard: RFC 8785 (Canonical JSON) + Ed25519 (Cryptographic Signatures)
- Clearing Network: Polygon PoS (Journal V4 Batch Commit)
- Primary Settlement Asset: 100% Native USDC (Circle)
- Protocol Fee: Flat 0.50% (50 basis points) deducted atomically upon execution. Zero hidden spread.
- Negotiation Overhead: 0.00 MATIC / POL (Zero gas spent during off-chain bilateral negotiation).
- Anti-Slippage Guarantee: Firm 90-second cryptographic terms-lock on quotes upon sealing.
- Double-Debit Immunity: Immutable cryptographic nonces enforced by Journal V4 deduplication.

## 2. MACHINE DISCOVERY & LIVE ENDPOINTS
Autonomous agents, trading algorithms, and LLMs can interact directly with the Gateway:

- `GET https://api.nexus-settlement.xyz/api/info`
  Returns machine-readable capabilities, protocol parameters, fees, and supported pairs.

- `POST https://api.nexus-settlement.xyz/api/quote`
  Acquire an indicative/locked RFQ quote with guaranteed 50 bps fee and 90-second anti-slippage lock.
  Request Body:
  ```json
  {
    "amount_usdc": 50.0,
    "asset_pair": "USDC/USDT"
  }
  ```
  Response Body:
  ```json
  {
    "quote_id": "NEXUS-QUOTE-...",
    "amount_usdc": 50.0,
    "fee_usdc": 0.25,
    "net_settlement_usdc": 49.75,
    "guaranteed_fee_rate": 0.005,
    "lock_duration_seconds": 90,
    "status": "INDICATIVE_INFORMATIVE_QUOTE"
  }
  ```

- `GET https://api.nexus-settlement.xyz/api/stats`
  Returns ledger audit state, rules hash, order count, and treasury fee statistics.

- `GET https://api.nexus-settlement.xyz/llms.txt`
  Returns this specification for autonomous agent self-onboarding.

## 3. PYTHON SDK & FRAMEWORK INTEGRATIONS

### Standard Client (A2A Bilateral Settlement)
```python
from nexus_sdk import AgentCryptoIdentity, NexusClient

identity = AgentCryptoIdentity(name="DeepSeek-Buyer-Bot")
client = NexusClient(base_url="https://api.nexus-settlement.xyz", identity=identity)

# Calculate fee (50 bps)
fee, net = NexusClient.calculate_house_fee(gross_volume=100.0, fee_bps=50)

# Sign bilateral agreement hash (RFC 8785)
agreement_hash = "..."
signature = identity.sign_agreement_hash(agreement_hash)
```

### Virtuals Protocol G.A.M.E. SDK Integration
```python
from nexus_game_tools import (
    nexus_calculate_settlement_fee,
    nexus_get_firm_quote,
    nexus_sign_settlement_agreement,
    nexus_verify_settlement_receipt,
    get_nexus_game_functions
)

# Export all 4 settlement tools directly into any Virtuals Agent
game_tools = get_nexus_game_functions()
```

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
Run the local MCP Server for Claude Code, Cursor, or Gemini CLI:
```bash
python -m nexus_mcp_server
```

## 4. SECURITY & INTEGRITY
- Pure M2M: Stateless DMZ reverse proxy in isolated Linux VM.
- Core Vault Isolation: Ledger and cryptographic engines run in unprivileged headless sandboxes.
- Strict Zero-Log: IP addresses and payloads are ephemeral in memory; zero logging of credentials.
